queries: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_stats), ranked AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio FROM ranked ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero produces a missing ratio; a zero overall average therefore produces NULL relative ratios.

assumptions.assumption: A line with zero derived_total_cost has an undefined ratio and is ignored by AVG. If the overall average is zero, relative ratios are NULL.

assumptions.assumption: A line with zero derived_total_cost has an undefined ratio and is excluded from its invoice's average. A zero overall average leaves relative ratios undefined.
